name: Setsuna Nasunaga
source:
Laid-back and casual, Setsuna is one of the more playful members of the Human Reignition Project, bringing her signature brand of wit and humor to a group that sorely needs it. Not one to sweat the small stuff, Setsuna goes for the gusto and wishes to experience the most out of life.

Like most children her age, Setsuna was home schooled, adding to the isolation that already came with being from a wealthy family, something very trialing for a natural extrovert. Because of this, she has opted to move out on her own and do what she's always wanted to - connect with people.

It's for this reason that Setsuna is prompted to join the HRP. Because if she can't connect with people here, then she may as well just give up.
